dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: #Heya, {NICKNAME}! I was just thinking about you! It's been ages since I last saw you — there's so much we gotta chat about!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Sure has! And what a coincidence to run into you here, luck must be on my side. Is there anything special going on here today?

choices.text: I'm on a quest to take pictures of lovely scenery, and I bumped into you on the way.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: That's a great idea, but how are you going to take any pictures without a Kamera? Are you sure you brought yours along?

choices.text: I'm on a quest to find the lovely Yoimiya, and I'm taking some pictures along the way.
